mapper.sql: oprt_std_id, aply_bgn_ym, oprt_std_nm, num_val, txt_val, unit_nm, use_plc_desc
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id)
FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY oprt_std_id ASC, aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id = #{key} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT MAX(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd = 'CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std ( oprt_std_id, aply_bgn_ym, oprt_std_nm, num_val, txt_val, unit_nm, use_plc_desc, created_by ) VALUES ( #{row.oprtStdId}, #{row.aplyBgnYm}, #{row.oprtStdNm}, #{row.numVal,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{row.txtVal,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.unitNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.usePlcDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) ON CONFLICT (oprt_std_id, aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET num_val = EXCLUDED.num_val, txt_val = EXCLUDED.txt_val
